description: This Java class implements a custom TrustManager for SSL, named MultiTrustManager, which manages multiple KeyStores and verifies certificates against them.

classes.name: MultiTrustManager
classes.description: A class that implements X509TrustManager to validate SSL certificates using multiple KeyStores.

methods.name: MultiTrustManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the manager with a KeyStore.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a KeyStore to the list of keystores managed by this instance.

methods.name: getNumberOfKeyStores
methods.description: Returns the number of KeyStores managed.

methods.name: checkClientTrusted
methods.description: Checks if the provided client certificates are trusted.

methods.name: checkServerTrusted
methods.description: Checks if the provided server certificates are trusted.

methods.name: getAcceptedIssuers
methods.description: Returns a list of trusted issuer certificates derived from managed KeyStores.

methods.name: isTrusted
methods.description: Internal method to verify if a given certificate chain is trusted.
